script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text doesn't establish where Peter encountered a city wall or say that he didn't turn back at one.
The passage doesn't give the distance Peter followed, so it doesn't establish that it was a long way.
Peter sits with the officers, but the text doesn't say he is out in the open.
The explanation repeats what inconsistent means without adding a distinct or fatherly thought. It reads like a generic answer key.
Inconsistent testimony doesn't establish that there were a lot of different versions.
The explanation repeats twice that the testimony was false, without adding anything beyond the answer. It reads like a generic answer key.
The cooling joke doesn't click: a cookie batch taking more than three days to cool has no clear connection to the claim about rebuilding.
The passage doesn't establish that the witnesses against Jesus are the only witnesses in the room.
The explanation adds that the Christ is God's promised King without a reference for that fact outside this passage.
The apron joke compares an accidental tear with the high priest deliberately tearing his clothes. The actions don't match.
The text says the high priest tore his clothes, but doesn't say what happened to them afterward.
The text says Peter denied it again, but doesn't say he answered the servant girl directly or give his words on this occasion.
Peter weeps, but saying he can't hold it in adds an unmarked claim about his ability to control his feelings.
